title: Sampler vs class-weighted CE strategy switch
description: Add --strategy {sampler,class_weighted} to src/train_classifier.py: 'sampler' = current WeightedRandomSampler (default, backward compat), 'class_weighted' = plain shuffle + CrossEntropyLoss with weights from train manifest class counts. Record strategy + class counts in checkpoint hyperparams and metrics json so Phase 6 matrix is comparable. Unit test: class weights computed from counts, label 0 = Damaged mapping preserved (weight index 0 = Damaged). Tooling only — comparison runs happen in Phase 6 with approval.
acceptance_criteria: --strategy class_weighted uses CrossEntropyLoss(weight=...) from train class counts
Class weights indexed by class_names order ('Damaged','Not Damaged') — Damaged weight at index 0
Checkpoint hyperparams + metrics json record strategy and class counts
